stellar_lang.config.title: Stellar Lang Settings
stellar_lang.config.enabled.comment: Master switch to enable or disable all Stellar Lang translations
stellar_lang.config.translation_plugin.c: Active translation provider plugin (e.g. onnx, libretranslate, deepl, google)
stellar_lang.config.detection_plugin.com: Active language detection provider plugin (e.g. onnx, libretranslate, deepl, google)
stellar_lang.config.target_language.comm: Target language code (e.g. auto, en, es, fr, de, ja, zh). 'auto' infers from game setting.
stellar_lang.config.translate_chat.comme: Enable translation of in-game chat messages
stellar_lang.config.translate_player_nam: Enable translation of player names across chat and entity nametags
stellar_lang.config.sign_tooltips.commen: Enable floating tooltips and indicators for translated signs
stellar_lang.config.sign_raycast_interva: Interval in milliseconds between raycast line-of-sight checks for sign tooltips
stellar_lang.config.translate_books.comm: Enable translation of books with area and page context
stellar_lang.config.translate_entities.c: Enable translation of entity custom and display names
stellar_lang.config.translate_items.comm: Enable translation of item display and custom names
stellar_lang.config.translate_containers: Enable translation of renamed container and inventory labels
stellar_lang.config.translate_map_banner: Enable translation of banners and markers on maps
stellar_lang.config.hide_indicators.comm: Hide the visual flag and [...] status indicators on translated text
stellar_lang.config.show_original_key.co: Key code to show original text on signs and entities
stellar_lang.config.retry_target_key.com: Key code to retry/refresh translation for targeted object
stellar_lang.config.cache_to_disk.commen: Enable persistent disk caching of translations across game sessions
stellar_lang.config.max_cache_entries.co: Maximum number of translations to keep in memory/disk cache
stellar_lang.config.show_error_toasts.co: Show in-game toast notifications for the first occurrence of API errors
stellar_lang.toast.rate_limited: API rate limit reached. Backing off automatically.
stellar_lang.toast.quota_exceeded: Monthly translation quota exhausted. Check your plan or change provider.
stellar_lang.toast.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your API key in settings.
stellar_lang.toast.connection_refused: Connection refused. Ensure your translation server is running.
stellar_lang.toast.network_error: Cannot connect to server. Check your network connection.
stellar_lang.toast.server_error: Translation server error. Falling back to alternative provider.
stellar_lang.toast.model_not_ready: Local model not ready. Download model or enable auto-download.
